<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F5F6"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="20" y="21" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#1F2125">9:41</text>
  <rect x="322" y="11" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>
  <rect x="328" y="9" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>
  <rect x="334" y="7" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>
  <rect x="340" y="5" width="3" height="11" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="12" r="2" fill="#1F2125"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="16" x2="358" y2="16" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="368" y="6" width="18" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="370" y="8" width="13" height="7" rx="2" fill="#31BD00"/>
  <rect x="386" y="9" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>

  <!-- Selection sheet shadow and panel -->
  <rect x="15" y="123" width="360" height="604" rx="24" fill="#00000033" opacity="0.12"/>
  <rect x="15" y="118" width="360" height="604" rx="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="169" y="133" width="52" height="5" rx="3" fill="#B2B5BB"/>

  <!-- Header controls -->
  <polyline points="43,180 35,188 43,196" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="35" y1="188" x2="54" y2="188" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="181" x2="353" y2="197" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="181" x2="337" y2="197" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <text x="32" y="239" font-family="Inter" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Choose an account</text>
  <text x="32" y="266" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Select one option to continue</text>
  <text x="328" y="266" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">3 options</text>

  <!-- Option one -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="291" width="328" height="88" rx="12" fill="#F0FBF8" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="335" r="22" fill="#B8EDDC"/>
    <text x="61" y="341" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#009A67">P</text>
    <text x="96" y="326" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F2125">Personal account</text>
    <text x="96" y="350" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Private workspace · Updated today</text>
    <circle cx="334" cy="335" r="11" fill="#009A67"/>
    <polyline points="329,335 333,339 340,331" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="31" y1="395" x2="359" y2="395" stroke="#F3F5F6" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Option two -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="407" width="328" height="88" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="451" r="22" fill="#D8E0F3"/>
    <text x="61" y="457" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#4367BC">T</text>
    <text x="96" y="442" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F2125">Team workspace</text>
    <text x="96" y="466" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">12 members · Last active 2h ago</text>
    <circle cx="334" cy="451" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B2B5BB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="31" y1="511" x2="359" y2="511" stroke="#F3F5F6" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Option three -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="523" width="328" height="88" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="61" cy="567" r="22" fill="#E3EEFF"/>
    <text x="61" y="573" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#65A3FF">B</text>
    <text x="96" y="558" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F2125">Business account</text>
    <text x="96" y="582" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#777777">Company profile · 4 projects</text>
    <circle cx="334" cy="567" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B2B5BB" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="31" y="642" width="328" height="52" rx="16" fill="#009A67"/>
    <text x="195" y="675" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="88" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="756" x2="390" y2="756" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,784 49,775 59,784" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="42" y="783" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Home</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Browse selected -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="146" cy="785" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="152" y1="792" x2="158" y2="798" stroke="#009A67" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="146" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#009A67">Browse</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Activity -->
  <g>
    <rect x="231" y="776" width="18" height="18" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="235,786 239,790 246,782" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="240" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Activity</text>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="335" cy="781" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="335" cy="794" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="335" y="820" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
